```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Noise is 1.8x the model: the PMOS load gate is driven by a 2 uA reference mirrored about 7x, so MN3, MP3 and iref noise reach node x amplified (~1.8 mS equivalent gm vs gm1 0.24 mS). Add an RC filter (5 MΩ, 2 pF, ~16 kHz) on the M2 gate and model the mirror noise."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),
    "L1":    (0.2, 0.15, 0.6),
    "I1":    (16e-6, 8e-6, 22e-6),
    "Isf":   (6e-6, 3e-6, 10e-6),
    "gmid_sf": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),
    "Lsf":   (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),
    "Rf":    (300e3, 255e3, 420e3),
    "gmid_p": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Ip":    (2e-6, 1e-6, 5e-6),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    VDD = 1.8
    kT4 = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    gamma = 0.8

    I1, Isf, Ip, Rf = p["I1"], p["Isf"], p["Ip"], p["Rf"]

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.2)
    vout_dc = m1.vgs
    msf = lut.size("n", p["gmid_sf"], p["Lsf"], Isf, vds=VDD - vout_dc, vsb=vout_dc)
    vx = vout_dc + msf.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vx)
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=max(VDD - vx, 0.2))
    mp3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Ip, vds=m2.vgs)
    gmid_b, Lb = 10.0, 1.0
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    mn3 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, Ip, vds=max(VDD - mp3.vgs, 0.2))
    msnk = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, Isf, vds=max(vout_dc, 0.2))

    # RC noise filter on the PMOS load gate (no DC current flows in Rflt)
    Rflt, Cflt = 5e6, 2e-12

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "x", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "pbf", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.R("RFLT", "pb", "pbf", Rflt)
    n.C("CFLT", "pbf", "vdd", Cflt)
    n.dev("MP3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp3)
    n.dev("MN3", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn3)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MSF", "vdd", "x", "vout", "vss", msf)
    n.dev("MSNK", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", msnk)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)

    go_x = m1.gds + m2.gds
    A1 = m1.gm / go_x
    gsf_out = msf.gm + msf.gmbs + msf.gds + msnk.gds
    Asf = msf.gm / gsf_out
    A0 = A1 * Asf
    Cx = m1.cdd + m2.cdd + msf.cgd + msf.cgg * (1 - Asf) * 0.7
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg + m1.cgd * A1
    wx = go_x / Cx
    ws = gsf_out / (cl + msnk.cdd + 0.3 * msf.cgg)

    f = np.logspace(4, 10, 3000)
    s = 2j * PI * f
    A = A0 / ((1 + s / wx) * (1 + s / ws))
    G = 1.0 / Rf
    Zt = A / (s * Cin + G * (1 + A))
    mag = np.abs(Zt)
    z0 = mag[0]
    below = np.where(mag < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = float(f[below[0]]) if len(below) else float(f[-1])

    w1m = 2 * PI * 1e6
    # mirror noise reaching M2 gate, attenuated by RC filter at 1 MHz
    ratio = I1 / Ip
    filt = 1.0 / (1 + (w1m * Rflt * Cflt) ** 2)
    gm_mir = (mp3.gm + mn3.gm) * ratio ** 2 * filt
    # thermal + rough flicker allowance (1.3x)
    en2 = 1.3 * kT4 * gamma * (m1.gm + m2.gm + gm_mir) / m1.gm ** 2
    in2 = kT4 / Rf + en2 * (G ** 2 + (w1m * Cin) ** 2)
    in_noise = math.sqrt(in2)

    power = VDD * (iref + Ip + I1 + Isf)

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": db(z0),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "power": power,
        "in_noise_1m": in_noise,
        "vout_dc": vout_dc,
    }
```
